sources.shortCitation: Salabert 3384, Henry Garat, “Pourvu qu’on ait vingt ans” (1933)
sources.fullCitation: Henry Garat, vocal; orchestra conducted by Bronisław Kaper. “Pourvu qu’on ait vingt ans,” from Une femme au volant. Music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann; words by Louis Poterat. Salabert 3384, 78 rpm disc, 7 November 1933. Digital transfer from David Silvestre’s private collection, published by lysgauty1 on YouTube, video JA57rCoKoyI. Gérard Roig, “Discographie d’Henry Garat,” Phonoscopies 5 (January 1994): 11, lists Salabert 3384 for the coupled side “Ninon, quand tu me souris.”
